available.quote: An individual who is currently licensed as a resident insurance producer in another state or territory may apply to the department for a nonresident insurance producer license for the equivalent lines of authority as the individual is licensed in the individual's home state.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a current resident producer license in another state/territory, submit a completed application, proof of home state license, and the required fee. The department may deny if the applicant's home state does not award nonresident licenses to PA residents on the same basis.
requirements.quote: The department may deny the application if the individual's home state does not award nonresident insurance producer licenses to resident licensees of this Commonwealth on the same basis.

definition_quote.value: A person that sells, solicits or negotiates contracts of insurance.
definition_quote.quote: "Insurance producer." A person that sells, solicits or negotiates contracts of insurance.

methods_authorized.quote: a person shall not sell, solicit or negotiate a contract of insurance in this Commonwealth unless the person is licensed as an insurance producer for the line of authority under which the contract is issued.

value: Variable life and variable annuity products
lines_of_authority.quote: "Line of authority." The licensed ability to sell, solicit or negotiate particular classes or types of insurance, including the following: (1) Life. (2) Accident and health or sickness. (3) Property. (4) Casualty. (5) Variable life and variable annuity products. (6) Personal lines. (7) Credit. (8) Motor vehicle rental. (9) Limited line.

resident_license_available.quote: An applicant with a principal place of residence or business within this Commonwealth may apply to the department for a resident insurance producer license.

nonresident_license_available.quote: An applicant with a principal place of residence or business outside this Commonwealth may apply for a nonresident insurance producer license.

preexamination_education_hours.quote: an individual who desires to be licensed as an insurance producer shall complete a minimum of 24 credit hours of approved preexamination courses.

preexamination_ethics_hours.quote: A preexamination education program approved by the department shall include no less than three credit hours on ethics.

exam_waiver_designations.quote: A person who possesses the professional designation of Chartered Life Underwriter (CLU)... Chartered Property and Casualty Underwriter (CPCU)... Certified Insurance Counselor (CIC)

business_entity_license_available.quote: a business entity may apply to the department for an insurance producer license for the same lines of authority held by the designated licensees.

designated_licensee_required_for_busines.quote: Upon designating one or more individuals licensed under this act to be responsible for the business entity's compliance with the insurance laws and regulations of the Commonwealth, a business entity may apply to the department for an insurance producer license

temporary_license_available.quote: the department may issue a temporary insurance producer license to the following persons

temporary_license_max_days.quote: The temporary license shall be for a period not to exceed 180 days and is not transferable.

appointment_required_to_represent_insure.quote: An insurance producer shall not act on behalf of or as a representative of the insurer unless the insurance producer is appointed by the insurer.

appointment_fee.value: $12.50 billed annually to the insurer for each producer appointed during the preceding calendar year
appointment_fee.quote: An appointment fee of $12.50 will be billed annually to the insurer for each producer appointed by the insurer during the preceding calendar year regardless of the length of time the producer held the appointment with the insurer.

appointment_termination_reporting_days.quote: An insurer which terminates an appointment pursuant to section 671-A(d) shall notify the department in writing on a form approved by the department, or through an electronic process approved by the department, within 30 days following the effective date of the termination.

written_consumer_representation_agreemen.quote: An insurance producer acting on behalf of or representing an insurance consumer shall execute a written agreement with the insurance consumer prior to representing or acting on their behalf

fiduciary_duty_for_funds.quote: An insurance producer shall be responsible in a fiduciary capacity for all funds received or collected as an insurance producer

rebates_prohibited.quote: No insurance producer shall, directly or indirectly, offer, promise, allow, give, set off or pay a rebate of, or part of, a premium payable on the contract of insurance or on the insurance producer's commission

additional_fee_for_commercial_business_a.quote: A licensee may charge a fee in addition to a commission to a person for the sale, solicitation or negotiation of a contract of insurance for commercial business.

misconduct_reporting_to_department_days.quote: A licensee shall report to the department any administrative action taken against the licensee in another jurisdiction or by another governmental agency in this Commonwealth within 30 days of the final disposition of the matter.

financial_institution_insurance_sales_re.quote: Sales of annuities or insurance, except credit insurance, by a financial institution or by a licensee employed by or affiliated with the financial institution shall take place in a location which is distinct from the area where deposits are taken and loan applications are discussed and accepted.

conditional_loan_insurance_tying_prohibi.quote: No financial institution or its directors, officers, employees, agents or insurance producers may require the purchase of insurance from the financial institution or its affiliates or from a designated insurer or insurance producer as a condition of a loan or deposit transaction.

manager_exclusive_general_agent_license_.quote: no person shall engage in any activities requiring a manager or exclusive general agent license without being licensed as a manager or exclusive general agent by the department.
A license issued in accordance with this section shall be for a period of not more than one year.

naic_producer_database_used_for_verifica.quote: The department may verify the individual's licensing status through the Producer Database maintained by the NAIC.

home_state_change_application_window_day.quote: Within 90 days of establishing a principal place of residence or business in this Commonwealth, the individual shall submit to the department a completed application

lapsed_license_reinstatement_window_days.quote: A licensee who allows his or her license to lapse by failing to timely renew the license, pay the fee required by this act or complete the continuing education required by this act may within one year of the license renewal date request the department to reinstate the license.

fingerprint_submission_required.quote: the applicant's fingerprints, in order for the department to receive national criminal history records information from the Federal Bureau of Investigation Criminal Justice Information Services Division
